paragraphs: Three independent fostering agencies list Islington as an area they cover, and they are shown above. Islington Council also runs its own fostering service, and its recruitment, together with that of Barnet, Camden, Enfield, Hackney and Haringey, is now run jointly as Foster North London, the North London Fostering Hub. Fostering for the council means caring for Islington's own children with its social workers, with meetings and family time kept local, within about an hour's travel; an independent agency assesses, trains and supervises you itself and is asked by councils to find homes for the children they look after.

Ofsted inspected Islington's children's services over two weeks in December 2024 and rated them outstanding in every area, including the experiences of children in care, as it had in 2020. Inspectors found that foster carers receive comprehensive support and training from "a stable and experienced staff team".

The council says it needs foster carers for children of all ages, and names children seeking asylum and separated children, mothers with babies, children with complex needs and disabled children among them. Alongside short-term and long-term fostering it offers specialist care, short breaks for disabled children, respite, supported lodgings for 16 to 21-year-olds and a reunification project that helps children return safely to their families. Department for Education figures reported in 2024 showed 325 Islington children looked after in March 2023, down from 385 a year earlier, with 64 of them living more than 20 miles from home.

Council carers who live in Islington are exempt from council tax, and the council pays for Fostering Network membership, reimburses housing benefit lost because of fostering and gives a reward when someone you recommend is approved. We do not yet have an Islington allowance page, so ask the council and the agencies above for their rates and compare the support each one gives.
Nearby, the pages for Haringey, Hackney and Barnet, or London as a whole, list more services.
